meta.title: Jo Kevin Nathaniel — Software Engineer & IT Infrastructure
meta.description: Jo Kevin Nathaniel — software engineer focused on IT infrastructure and security. Projects, experience, and contact.

hero.name: Jo Kevin Nathaniel
hero.tagline: I build secure, reliable systems — from the web app down to the server that keeps it running.

about.whoami: Software engineer working across web development and IT infrastructure. I care about systems that stay up, stay fast, and stay secure. My happy place is where application code meets the network, the server, and the security posture underneath it.

bullets: Operate and monitor hybrid infrastructure: on-prem servers, VLAN segmentation, and cloud VPS across two data centers.
Automate provisioning and patching with Ansible and PowerShell, cutting manual setup time by 60%.
Maintain firewall, VPN, and access-control policy; lead internal phishing-response drills.
Built and maintained internal dashboards and REST APIs with Vue, TypeScript, and Node.js.
Containerized deployments with Docker and set up CI pipelines, reducing release time from hours to minutes.
Harded endpoints and web services: TLS everywhere, rate limiting, dependency auditing, and log review.
Delivered client sites and admin panels with Vue and Laravel.
Migrated a legacy PHP admin to a role-based Vue dashboard used daily by 40+ staff.
Set up Linux VPS hosting, Nginx, and automated backups for every client deployment.
